page.overview:
Who is Mount Hio Eruption Devil?

The の|Hio-san Funka no Akuma}} is a Devil that embodies the concept of the eruption of Mount Hio.

The Mount Hio Eruption Devil's appearance is currently unknown.

The Mount Hio Eruption Devil's personality is currently unknown.

At some point, prior to the events of Chainsaw Man, the Mount Hio Eruption Devil was eaten by Pochita, thus ridding its existence along with the existence of the eruption of Mount Hio from the world.
